summary.en: Find leaders, partition indexed TAC and build exact control-flow edges with a Python implementation.
summary.bn: তুমি jump-এর গন্তব্য দেখে ইনস্ট্রাকশনগুলোকে ব্লকে ভাগ করবে এবং কোন ব্লক থেকে কোথায় যাওয়া যায় দেখবে।

notes: Python programs use the standard library and were executed with Python 3.12.14.

examples.title: Build the loop partition and CFG
examples.explanationHtml: The loop has six blocks, and B4 returns to the test in B1.

examples.title: Retain a skipped assignment as a block
examples.explanationHtml: B1 has an outgoing edge but no reachable incoming path from entry.

examples.title: Check boundary cases for targets
examples.explanationHtml: An empty list has no blocks; a zero-target goto forms a self-loop; target 1 is invalid for length 1.

practice.title: Partition structured TAC
practice.statementHtml: Read a JSON list of up to 100 instruction records. Each record is ["assign"], ["return"], ["if", TARGET] or ["goto", TARGET]. TARGET must be a non-Boolean integer in range. Print Instructions:, then BNUMBER: space-separated member indices -> space-separated successor names. Print exit when there are no successors, empty for no instructions, or invalid for an illegal operation or target. The outer list and record shapes follow this grammar.
hints: Mark all target and post-transfer leaders before building blocks.

practice.title: Report leader indices
practice.statementHtml: Read the same structured TAC format. Print Instructions for leaders:, then sorted leader indices separated by spaces. Print empty for an empty list and invalid for an illegal operation or target. Include the next instruction after return or goto even if it is unreachable.
hints: A block begins at each sorted leader.

practice.title: Build complete loop edges
practice.statementHtml: For the seven-instruction loop in the lesson, show every CFG successor and justify omitted fallthrough edges.
hints: Only a conditional has both taken and fallthrough possibilities.
practice.answerHtml:
Successor construction
BlockTaken targetFallthrough targetFinal successors
B0noneB1B1
B1B5B2B2,B5
B2B4B3B3,B4
B3noneB4B4
B4B1noneB1
B5nonenoneexit

The edge B4→B1 is a back edge in this example's loop. B1's false condition path enters B2; its true path leaves for B5. A graph can contain a cycle without guaranteeing that execution terminates. Termination also depends on updates and conditions, such as whether i eventually reaches n.

The word exit in the program's printed display means that there is no successor block in the list. It is not a new numbered block. A later analysis can add a synthetic exit vertex if it needs one. Keep that convention consistent when presenting predecessor sets or data-flow boundaries.

practice.title: Keep unreachable regions
practice.statementHtml: Partition 0:goto 2; 1:x=99; 2:return x, then identify which block entry cannot reach.
hints: Boundary detection does not delete instructions.
practice.answerHtml:
Take 0: goto 2; 1: x=99; 2: return x. All three instructions are leaders: entry marks 0, the goto marks target 2, and the following instruction marks 1. The edge from B0 goes directly to B2, leaving B1 unreachable from entry.

Partition first, then check reachability
BlockMembersSuccessorsReachable from entry?
B00B2Yes
B11B2No
B22exitYes

Keeping B1 in the initial partition does not claim that it executes. It preserves a faithful view of the input code. Once reachability is known, an optimisation may remove B1 if the language's observable semantics allow that removal.

quiz.prompt: Which instruction is always a leader in a nonempty function list?
quiz.explanation: The entry instruction starts the first block.

quiz.prompt: Which operation has no internal successor in this model?
quiz.explanation: A return leaves the function rather than falling through.

quiz.prompt: Why mark the instruction after goto as a leader?
options: Because every assignment is a target
To end the previous block even if the next code is unreachable
quiz.explanation: Partitioning retains unreachable code as separate straight-line regions.

quiz.prompt: If a conditional target equals its fallthrough, how many distinct successor edges remain?
quiz.explanation: Successors are a set of destination blocks, so duplicate destinations merge.

quiz.prompt: What must happen to an out-of-range jump target?
quiz.explanation: This representation requires targets to name existing instructions.

quiz.prompt: What is the expected block result for an empty list?
options: One empty block with a self-loop
quiz.explanation: No entry instruction exists to create a leader.

quiz.prompt: Why is a branch target in the middle of a proposed block invalid?
options: It creates another entry into that block
quiz.explanation: A basic block must be entered only at its first instruction.

quiz.prompt: Leader indices are sorted before partitioning. What list is printed?
quiz.explanation: The set stores distinct leaders; sorting establishes instruction order.

quiz.prompt: A conditional has the same taken and fallthrough block. How many distinct edges print?
quiz.explanation: A set removes the duplicate successor.

quiz.prompt: A goto terminates B0. Which successor count follows the stated rule?
quiz.explanation: Only its target is added; the next physical block is not an extra path.

keyPoints.en: Every branch target begins a basic block.
keyPoints.bn: প্রতিটি jump target থেকে নতুন বেসিক ব্লক শুরু করো।

keyPoints.en: A transfer ends the current straight-line block.
keyPoints.bn: কন্ট্রোল অন্য পথে গেলে বর্তমান সোজা ব্লকটি সেখানেই শেষ হয়।

keyPoints.en: Conditional branches may have taken and fallthrough successors.
keyPoints.bn: শর্তযুক্ত jump-এ গন্তব্য আর পরের ব্লক, দুদিকে যাওয়া সম্ভব।

keyPoints.en: Unconditional jumps do not create an extra fallthrough edge.
keyPoints.bn: শর্তহীন jump-এর পরে বাড়তি fallthrough edge দিও না।

keyPoints.en: Reachability is analysed after all instructions are partitioned.
keyPoints.bn: সব ইনস্ট্রাকশন ব্লকে ভাগ করার পরে কোনগুলোতে পৌঁছানো যায় দেখো।

examQuestions.question: State the leader rules and explain why a return must end a basic block.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
How to mark leaders
RuleMarkReason
EntryInstruction 0 when presentExecution begins here
Branch targetEvery if or goto targetAnother path can enter here
After a transferThe next instruction after if, goto or return, when presentThe preceding block must end at the transfer

Marking after an unconditional goto or return can create an unreachable block. That is still useful when partitioning the entire instruction list. Reachability is a separate graph traversal from the entry block. Do not silently drop code before you have constructed and understood the graph.
